notes.title: ⏳📝Current development plan
notes.content: [h3]Prologue[/h3][p]With the update of the version 0.2.x, the concrete story and gameplay of the game Oru would be gradually present to everyone and improved in the later development. And in order to make it easier for players to discuss or make suggestion, the future general development plan is shown here as a convenience.[/p][h3]Plan[/h3][olist][*][p][strike]Rhythm game part[/strike] (Completed)[/p][olist][*][p][strike]Create the Osu-like click rhythm game, and add extra creating beatmap function, which makes everyone could share their beatmap or the things related to the beatmap.[/strike] (Completed)[/p][/*][*][p][strike]Add the hidden mind power four attributes system.[/strike] (Completed)[/p][/*][*][p]Add user-defined emoji by mod. (W.I.P.)[/p][/*][*][p]With the convenience of the Godot engine, the player can make their own world mod by the engine. (W.I.P.)[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]First world part (Under development)[/p][olist][*][p][strike]Basic attack, item and player attributes system. Enemy and npc basic function. The enemy and the map's basic configuration of the first 10 floors.[/strike] (Completed)[/p][/*][*][p]The story complement, special items and system optimzation. [/p][/*][*][p]The story complement, special items and enemies configuration of 20 and 30 floors.[/p][/*][*][p]The story complement, special items and enemies configuration of 40 and 50 floors.[/p][/*][*][p]The whole story optimization and adding multiple playthroughs function. Mind power attributes adjustment.[/p][/*][*][p]Add user-defined function of the player attributes' enhancement[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Second world part (W.I.P.)[/p][olist][*][p]Gameplay temporary mainly about the real time strategy. Other gameplay might be added for the story needed.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Third world part (W.I.P.)[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Ending[/h3][p]That's the currently overall development plan of the game Oru. Any modification of the plan would be editd here or give out a new event. Anyone who bought and played the game Oru is welcomed to give your own advice.[/p][p][/p][p]25.9.11 update[/p]

notes.title: 🆕🔄version 0.2.x updated!
notes.content: [p]Hi, everyone, 803games here.[/p][p][/p][p]Due to this major patch of the game, normal description is used for now. Please be relieved to read the news.[/p][p][/p][p]This time the update of the game [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517573/183abd53e19eaab64a3e58e4f9781cb25d830dd2.jpg"][/img]Oru, is mainly about the opening of the first world. The way to enter the world is easy to be known about if you play the game normally—when you get the scores of the three attached beatmaps over some degree, there would be a hint about the permission that you can entering the world of the beatmap, which can be shown like the picture below. Right click on the beatmap item to get the the entry, which is shown as the icon [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517573/2d6a06eef17e60c813064a86f729f2cbd627d9e1.png"][/img].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517573/eb0286c7ddb90c4fb6e770b9a4da393ed71999bf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And therefore you can play the new update about the game.[/p][p][/p][p]But beacause of the manpower, time and other stuff, the playable part of this world is now only first 10 floors, and there are many parts that might need to be fixed. Please leave your comment or advise below, or in steam community, or under other social media with the same team's name. The team would respond it as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, thanks for your support for the Oru and the team 803games. Enjoy you game's time.[/p][p][/p][p]P.S.: Due to the new content added, the game price will maintain original price until the last day of the August after this update. Starting from September, the game price would be up to 25 CNY. ( Other area would change the price based on this price. ) So please share or recommend the game to your friends to avoid missing the best price time.[/p]
